Hayes Warner is a pop singer based in New York City. She was born on July 16, 1999 to an American mother and Paraguayan father. She had breakout success in 2024. Her hits include Predator, Oh! and Zip.
In 2024, she performed at Lollapalooza.
Also in 2024, she released a remake of No Doubt's  “Just a Girl.”
